purpose: Deterministic lookup over a version-pinned mandate table: given supplier/buyer country, transaction type, and transaction date, routes to the applicable e-invoicing regime, format, phase status, and transmission channel. Covers France (PDP, B2B receive obligation live 2026-09-01), Germany (XRechnung), UAE (PINT-AE pilot), Malaysia (MyInvois), Belgium (Peppol BIS 3.0, mandatory since 2026-01-01), and Poland (KSeF FA(3), mandatory-use phase-in from 2026-02-01). Third node of the einvoice-validation-pipeline chain. Zero network, zero PII.
